recommended_record.title: Independent confirmation data for sequence versus causal necessity in the izu-core Model 3 plant–pollinator experiment
recommended_record.description: Prospectively frozen independent confirmation data for the Chapter 2 Model 3 process result. The archive contains 4,096 finite-population trajectories built from 64 new visitor histories and eight nested demographic repeats, together with the frozen design, compact confirmatory result, execution and summarization code, source identity and checksums. The primary result separates realized temporal order from causal necessity: in the declared delayed-selfing, assurance-cost 0.5, positive-mutation setting, reproductive assurance can change before floral investment declines, while a separate fixed-assurance intervention shows that investment decline does not require evolution of assurance capacity. Fixed assurance does not remove realized selfing.
